text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Nishino Flower attended a talk 
event under the theme of "Umamusume Who 
Made Waves."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a massive annual event held at a 
spacious venue, and on this day, in 
addition to Nishino Flower—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely love chatting! I've been 
sooo, soooo looking forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right, Taishin? You too, right, Taishin!? 
TAISHIIIIIIIIIN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously, so noisy...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Taishin in the Satsuki Sho, 
Winning Ticket in the Japanese Derby! And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am Biwa Hayahide. I look forward to 
working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Come on, say hello!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Biwa Hayahide, who split the Triple Crown 
with them! And her younger sister, the 
victor of the Asahi Hai FS, Narita 
Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, I wonder what kind of stories 
we'll get to hear!? I'm so glad I won the 
lottery ticket!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
—Me, as a guest at an event that 
Hayahide-san and the others are appearing 
in...!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
B-But... do you really think I'll be able 
to speak properly at such a big event...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"It's an event the fans look forward to 
every year, right? I heard it's even 
really tough to get tickets."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"If I mess up... I'll let so many people 
down."
choice_data_list: If you're feeling anxious, look at me.
If you're feeling anxious, look at me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Heh.
choice_data_list: Just talk the way you talk to me.

Just speak to them the same way you speak 
to me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I've got you with me, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list:
You're an amazing horse girl, so hold your 
head high!

You're an amazing horse girl—hold your 
head high!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: —Next up, it's Nishino Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: H-Hello, everyone. I'm Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Thank you very much for coming 
today. Nishino Flower is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Starting with your success in the Hanshin 
JF and Oka Sho, then the Yomiuri Milers 
Cup, Yasuda Kinen... and you even won the 
Mile Championship back-to-back, right?!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the major races alone, you have 
won this many wonderful titles!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh!!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much! Um...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I...! I tried my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Flower-chaaan!! 
Congratulaaatiooonssss!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you... so much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I hope we can all have a fun chat today. 
It's nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hafu~... My heart was pounding!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Nishino Flower handled the talk 
show splendidly, and thanks in part to her 
hard work, the event ended in great 
success.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I heard Trainer's voice cheering, "Do your 
best!" And then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm amazing, so I know I'll be fine!" I 
was able to stand tall with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that was truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-san!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That was an honest and gentle talk, very 
much like you. Along with my praise, allow 
me to express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A token of gratitude...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thanks to how smoothly and subtly you 
supported the discussion, the event was 
able to proceed without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just remember who's participating today. 
Ticket, who knows what she'll do, and 
Taishin, who isn't keen on talking...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And then there's Brian, blunt and a horse 
of few words. Before we started, I was 
worried whether we'd even be able to have 
a conversation, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your flower-like laughter, the way you 
give your all to any theme, and your 
thoughtful consideration for the other 
participants...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even Taishin and Brian did it. Whenever 
you spoke to them, they did their best in 
their own way to find the words to answer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket is extremely simple, after all. 
Influenced by your aura, she was calm the 
entire time, just like in her best 
moments.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks to you being here, today's event 
turned out to be the absolute best. So, 
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Also, being lined up alongside Umamusume 
who have achieved such incredible 
results... It's truly an honor.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
From here on out too—please keep showing 
your magnificent back to all the "next 
generation," including us.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. Thank you very much...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Hayahide-san praised me so much.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What a relief... So today, I was actually 
able to stand tall... with confidence.
choice_data_list: See, what did I tell you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list:
I'm telling you, you're an amazing horse 
girl!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! I... No, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "We are amazing♪"
